pure-announcement.rationale: It is the protocol's getting-started intro page, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the six specialized MCP concepts has the basic definition as its subject, though every one of them presupposes essentially everything this intro says.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The definitional claims about a public, open protocol are directly checkable against the specification and the named clients.

durability.rationale: Beyond the one-sentence definition, the content is a USB-C analogy, benefit bullets per audience, and a client adoption list (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor) — exactly the adoption-list material that ages badly.

actionability.rationale: It describes what MCP is and who supports it without any mechanism, trade-off or guidance that would change how someone builds or decides.

atomicity.rationale: It is a single definitional idea — MCP is an open standard for connecting AI applications to external systems — statable in one sentence.
